text:
The leather-jacketed CEO of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, has acknowledged an affair with Megaspeed exec Alice Huang, spurring an investigation by his company and intense discussions worldwide. Recent reporting noted that since last year, US intelligence reports had identified Alice Huang (no relation) as not only the exec for an AI compute company renting access to Nvidia GPUs, but also a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security.
In recent years, Nvidia has become a key part of the Trump administration’s AI push, a central figure in negotiations over potential Chinese access to cutting-edge AI hardware, and a company that has used its now $4 trillion-plus market cap to finance other AI companies, including the “neoclouds” like Coreweave who have been some of its biggest customers. So far, Nvidia and Jensen Huang have said that they have “no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised,” but that hasn’t settled things as the investigation continues.
- The future of AI hinges on… Jensen Huang’s sex life? I would prefer that these people’s sex lives were none of my business but I guess we have to talk about Jensen Huang and the National Security Incident. Who could have guessed that the guy who was out here signing titties might not have great judgment about how to behave around women? Alice Huang — no relation to Jensen — is a former TV reporter. That was before she became “an executive” at Megaspeed, which bought $4.8 billion of hard-to-get Nvidia chips, starting around the time she was being photographed with Jensen in a Taipei bar in 2024. “To many in the industry, the well-funded push by Megaspeed into A.I. appeared to come out of nowhere,” The New York Times wrote, tactfully. Our girl Alice is also an alleged honeypot who was recruited by the Chinese Ministry of State Security. (China is denying all this, btw.) Read Article >
- Here’s the full text of Jensen Huang’s memo to Nvidia On Sunday, Nvidia announced it was launching an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, an AI executive and agent of the Chinese government. In addition to the Board of Directors announcing the investigation, Huang sent a memo to Nvidia employees acknowledging the affair. You can read the full text below. Read Article >
- Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang’s relationship with an alleged Chinese spy Nvidia has announced that it is opening an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang and his relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, who was reportedly recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on the company. The New York Times reported last month that Huang had developed a “close relationship” with the Megaspeed executive, which he later admitted was romantic in nature in a memo to the company. US officials believe she was feeding information directly back to Beijing. Read Article >
digest_he:
מנכ"ל Nvidia, ג'נסן הואנג, הודה בקיומו של רומן עם אליס הואנג, בכירה בחברת Megaspeed, דבר שהצית חקירה פנימית של החברה ודיונים עולמיים סביב סוגיות של ביטחון לאומי. דיווחים מודיעיניים מארצות הברית ציינו כי אליס הואנג, שאין בינה לבין המנכ"ל קרבת משפחה, זוהתה לא רק כבכירה בחברת מחשוב בינה מלאכותית השוכרת גישה למעבדי Nvidia, אלא גם כמרגלת לכאורה מטעם משרד ביטחון המדינה של סין.

בשנים האחרונות הפכה Nvidia לשחקנית מרכזית בשוק הבינה המלאכותית ובדיונים סביב גישה סינית לחומרת מחשוב מתקדמת. עם שווי שוק העולה על ארבעה טריליון דולר, החברה מימנה חברות טכנולוגיה נוספות המשמשות כלקוחות מרכזיים שלה. עד כה, נמסר מטעם Nvidia והמנכ"ל כי אין להם סיבה להאמין שמידע סודי או ביטחוני נפגע, אך החקירה בעניין נמשכת.

הקשר בין השניים עלה לכותרות לאחר שחברת Megaspeed ביצעה רכישות גדולות של שבבים וצברה מימון רב שנראה תמוה לרבים בענף. ממשלת סין מצדה הכחישה את כל ההאשמות בנושא, בעוד שדירקטוריון Nvidia אישר את פתיחת הבדיקה העצמאית לגבי הקשר בין המנכ"ל לבכירה.
